title: Fangs of the Father
summary: Wrathion seeks a future beyond his flight’s corruption. His hidden campaign draws a rogue against the black dragons whose inherited darkness he has escaped.
opening: A black dragon newly freed from an inherited taint sought to choose his own future. His campaign made a rogue an unseen instrument of that choice.
reviewNote: Verify the original rogue chain. The participating player is not a named universal historical hero. Editorial chapter research tasks retained here: Review the Badlands events that preceded Wrathion's appearance. Trace his goals and the rogue's covert tasks. Follow the campaign's changing targets and costs. Connect its ending to Wrathion's later role in Pandaria.

chapters.title: An unusual origin
chapters.body: Events in the Badlands preceded Wrathion’s emergence, setting the beginning of a life he hoped to choose for himself.

chapters.title: The Black Prince's bargain
chapters.body: Freed from an inherited taint, the young black dragon drew a rogue into his hidden purpose.

chapters.title: Against the black dragons
chapters.body: A covert campaign moved against corrupted black dragons. Its changing targets carried Wrathion’s choice into the lives of others.

chapters.title: The prince remains
chapters.body: Beyond the campaign waited Pandaria and another part of Wrathion’s history. The road between them remains unfinished here.
